about: Crowd faces: walk-ons shown as faces only, other players at the games and, later, venue staff. Each id is the face's sheet and place on it: avatars-<n>.png, row r and column c of its 2x2 grid. type is patron or worker; venues lists the place ids (story.js) where the face may turn up. Chuy, Nick and Teddy (avatars-7) are the back-lot regulars at Millstone Lanes. tools/import_faces.py slices the sheets into the game (Resources/Faces/<id>.png) and copies this roster there as faces.json.
